json.description:
导出实体统计 (json 格式)：

执行后将输出实体统计信息。

list.code:
(progn
  (princ "\n实体统计:\n")
  (princ "类型              数量\n")
  (princ "---------------------\n")
  (setq ss(ssget "_X"))
  (if ss
    (progn
      (setq elst(mapcar(quote(lambda(x)(cdr(assoc 0(entget x))))) (pickset:to-list ss)))
      (foreach t '("LINE" "CIRCLE" "ARC" "TEXT" "MTEXT" "POLYLINE" "LWPOLYLINE" "INSERT")
        (setq cnt(length(member t elst)))
        (if(> cnt 0)(princ(strcat t "           "(itoa cnt) "\n")))
      )
    )
  )
)
